query: SELECT m.details_json FROM conversation_messages cm JOIN messages m ON m.id = cm.message_id WHERE cm.conversation_id = $1 AND m.role = 'user' AND CASE WHEN json_valid(m.details_json) THEN COALESCE(json_extract(m.details_json, '$.kind'), '') != 'compaction' ELSE true END ORDER BY cm.ordering DESC LIMIT 1
